== Biography ==
'''Cleora Glasgow''' was born about 1847, a daughter of [[Glasgow-3995|Hiram Wilson Glasgow]] and Mary Ann Brandon Kennedy. Her identification rests on two linked records: a biographical account names the Reverend Leonidas K. Glasgow as Hiram and Mary Ann's son, while Cleora's obituary calls Leonidas her brother.<ref>[https://newsofdavidson.org/2025/02/08/85148/davidson-history-the-reverend-leonidas-k-glasgow/ "Davidson History: The Reverend Leonidas K. Glasgow"], ''News of Davidson'', 8 February 2025.</ref><ref name="Obit">[https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/observer/1906-7s.htm "Newberry Observer abstracts, 1906–1907"], entry for Cleora Speers.</ref>

She married '''Leland McNary Speers''' on 17 October 1867 at the residence of her mother, Mrs. M. A. Glasgow.<ref>[https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/marriages_early.html "Early Newberry marriage notices"], notice published 23 October 1867.</ref> Their known children included Lucy Kennedy, Hiram Leonidas and Leland C. Speers.<ref name="Obit" />

Cleora died on 12 July 1927 aged about 80 and was buried at Rosemont Cemetery.<ref>[https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/observer/1927s.htm "Newberry Observer abstracts, 1927"], death notice for Cleora Speers.</ref>
